videos.headline: Kalen King snags Cameron Rising's pass for a Penn State INT
videos.description: Penn State gets the ball back as Kalen King lays out for the interception on the deep ball.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Kalen King snags Cameron Rising's pass for a Penn State INT) 2023/01/02 ESHEET

videos.headline: Penn State goes old school with TD on a straight-t formation
videos.description: Penn State takes an early lead as Nicholas Singleton follows his blockers into the end zone for a touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Penn State goes old school with TD on a straight-t formation) 2023/01/02 ESHEET

videos.headline: Thomas Yassmin makes nice TD grab to draw Utah even
videos.description: Utah evens it up as Cameron Rising finds Thomas Yassmin in the back of the end zone for a short touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Thomas Yassmin makes nice TD grab to draw Utah even) 2023/01/03 ESHEET

videos.headline: Ja'Quinden Jackson spins off defender in backfield for impressive TD
videos.description: Utah ties it up as Ja'Quinden Jackson spins off a tackler in the backfield before sprinting to the end zone for a 19-yard touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Ja'Quinden Jackson spins off defender in backfield for impressive TD) 2023/01/02 ESHEET

videos.headline: Nicholas Singleton makes 87-yard house call for Penn State
videos.description: Penn State takes the lead as Nicholas Singleton takes the handoff 87 yards for a touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Nicholas Singleton makes 87-yard house call for Penn State) 2023/01/02 ESHEET

videos.headline: Cameron Rising goes down with apparent leg injury
videos.description: Cameron Rising is shaken up by an apparent leg injury after getting tackled.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Cameron Rising goes down with apparent leg injury) 2023/01/02 ESHEET

videos.headline: Utah's Bryson Barnes intercepted by Ji'Ayir Brown
videos.description: Penn State gets the interception as Ji'Ayir Brown comes over from his safety position to pick off Bryson Barnes' pass.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Utah's Bryson Barnes intercepted by Ji'Ayir Brown) 2023/01/02 ESHEET

videos.headline: Penn State has longest pass TD in Rose Bowl history as Lambert-Smith goes 88 yards
videos.description: Sean Clifford finds an open KeAndre Lambert-Smith for an 88-yard touchdown, the longest in Rose Bowl history.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Penn State has longest pass TD in Rose Bowl history as Lambert-Smith goes 88 yards) 2023/01/02 ESHEET

videos.headline: Penn State increases lead on Kaytron Allen's TD
videos.description: Kaytron Allen's short touchdown gives Penn State a larger lead over Utah in the Rose Bowl.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Penn State increases lead on Kaytron Allen's TD) 2023/01/02 ESHEET

videos.headline: Sean Clifford gets standing ovation from Rose Bowl crowd
videos.description: Penn State quarterback Sean Clifford gets a standing ovation from the Rose Bowl crowd as he walks off the field.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Sean Clifford gets standing ovation from Rose Bowl crowd) 2023/01/02 ESHEET

videos.headline: James Franklin gets doused in Gatorade and rose petals after win
videos.description: Penn State coach James Franklin gets Gatorade and rose petals dumped on him after the Nittany Lions' win.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (James Franklin gets doused in Gatorade and rose petals after win) 2023/01/02 ESHEET

videos.headline: Penn State pulls away in 2nd half for Rose Bowl win
videos.description: Penn State scores 21 unanswered in the second half to pull away for the 35-21 win over Utah in the Rose Bowl.
